Overview

Grand Theft Auto VI is Rockstar Games’ next mainline open-world crime game, set in the Miami-inspired Vice City and the wider state of Leonida. You play as two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, a couple whose easy score goes wrong and drags them into a criminal conspiracy.

How the date moved

  • Dec 4, 2023: Trailer 1 announces a 2025 release window.
  • May 2024: window narrowed to fall 2025.
  • May 2, 2025: first delay, to May 26, 2026.
  • Nov 6, 2025: second delay, to Nov 19, 2026. It has held since.

Not announced yet

  • A PC version, with no date, window or store listing.
  • A GTA VI online mode, or any transfer of GTA Online progress.
  • A published map size.

Compiled Nov 18, 2026, mostly from the fan site GTA Boss and news coverage. Rockstar’s own channels have the final word.

Story and cast

Jason and Lucia are a couple. A job that should have been simple goes sideways and puts them in the middle of a conspiracy that spreads across Leonida. Both are playable, and Lucia is described as the first fully voiced female lead in a mainline GTA.

Jason Duval

Playable lead and one half of the central couple.

Lucia Caminos

Playable lead and the other half of the couple.

Cal Hampton

Jason’s laid-back friend.

Boobie Ike

Vice City businessman with a strip club and a recording studio.

Dre’Quan Priest

Runs a record label.

Real Dimez

A rap duo made up of Bae-Luxe and Roxy.

Raul Bautista

A veteran of robbery crews.

Brian Heder

A smuggler working out in the Keys.

Character art for several of them is in the Gallery tab.

The world

The game takes place in the state of Leonida, centered on Vice City. Six regions have been named so far:

  • Vice City
  • The Leonida Keys
  • Grassrivers
  • Mount Kalaga National Park
  • Port Gellhorn
  • Ambrosia

Rockstar hasn’t published how big the map is. Extras around launch:

  • A launch gallery of Vice City screenshots went up on the official GTA VI site on Nov 5.
  • On Nov 19, a printable cover-art poster and Leonida map becomes a free digital download on the official site.
  • A double-sided physical version follows after launch on the Rockstar Store, at $0.99 or free with any store purchase.

Music

Score and album

  • The original score is by the electronic duo Justice. The 30-track score album arrives Dec 11.
  • Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album has 34 original tracks, was made with Atlantic Records, and launches Nov 19.
  • The Launch Trailer song is Justice’s “Flower in a Hurricane”, which is also on the album. Tove Lo’s “Blood in Your Eyes” is on it too.

First six singles (Sep 17)

  • Yung Lean, “That’s It” (feat. Future and Metro Boomin)
  • Travis Scott, “RHYNO”
  • CA7RIEL and Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Etienne de Crécy, “Sexy Magic”
  • Morgan Wallen, “Last Thing You Need”
  • Rauw Alejandro, “Macacoa 2000”
  • Keith Richards, “Bright Lights, Big City”

Editions and extras

Standard

$79.99£69.99 / €79.99. Digital, or a boxed download code with no disc.

Ultimate

$99.99£89.99 / €99.99. Digital only. Adds Ultimate-only vehicles, a garage, weapons and five destinations. No early access.
  • Upgrading from Standard to Ultimate later costs $20 / £20 / €20 on Xbox.
  • Pre-orders, and purchases made before Nov 20, include the Vintage Vice City Pack. Boxed copies get it while stocks last.
  • Digital purchases before Nov 20 also include one month of GTA+. You claim it yourself, and it renews as a paid plan unless you cancel.
  • There is no collector’s edition of the game. The $399.99 “Goodtime State – Vice City Collection” box on the Rockstar Store is merchandise only, with the game sold separately. It has 11 items, including a Macca the Gator figure, Oakley Frogskins sunglasses and a snapback.

Platforms and performance

  • Native on PS5 (including PS5 Pro) and Xbox Series X|S. Not on PS4.
  • The target is 30 frames per second on both console families.
  • PS5 Pro adds sharper images through PSSR and ray-traced shadows, which are the only ray tracing announced.
  • PS5 adds adjustable DualSense haptics, Tempest 3D Audio and faster loading.
  • Remote Play works on PlayStation and Xbox.
  • Xbox One and Xbox Series owners can stream through Xbox Cloud Gaming from 1 a.m. ET on Nov 19, using Series S graphics settings. You still need to own the game, and cloud time is counted in hours.
  • The download is up to 212 GB, so check free space before launch.

PC

Nothing is announced. For reference only, GTA V reached consoles on Sep 17, 2013 and PC on Apr 14, 2015.

FAQ

What time does it unlock?

Midnight local time on Nov 19. In the US it is one moment for the whole country, 12:00 AM ET, which is 9:00 PM PT on Nov 18. That US timing isn’t officially confirmed yet.

Can I play early?

No. Preloading only downloads the game ahead of time. No early access has been announced.

Is there an online mode?

Not at launch. Rockstar calls the game a single-player experience, and GTA 5 Online is not shutting down.

Is it coming to PC?

No PC version has been announced.

Will it be delayed again?

No delay has been announced, and the date was restated in October by the Launch Trailer.

Can I play on Xbox One or PS4?

Not natively. Xbox One can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming. There is no PS4 version.

Is there a Trailer 3?

No video carries that name. Fans use it for An Extended Look from Aug 27.
